An officer of the Military Intelligence branch has crash-landed in bug territory. While no further information is provided, his extraction appears vital for the war effort.

To avoid the attraction of substantial Arachnid forces, small units of elite special forces have infiltrated the surroundings and must make their way to the crash site.

Command, we're at the designated drop point. We're beginning our search for the target's crashed dropship now.
OK, listen up. I’m Colonel Ava Cortez, and I’m in charge now. Colonel Hawthorne has been court-martialed for insubordination and dereliction of duty and removed from command.

In light of his distinguished service record, the Federation went easy on him. The usual punishment in wartime is a noose. And Command has graciously decided to overlook the actions of all you troopers who went along with his plan.
Listen, despite what you may think, I'm not celebrating Hawthorne's dismissal. The colonel was a friend and a good soldier, and he deserved better.
But he made his choice, and so things are gonna change around here, starting now.
Enough chit chat, we have a man to rescue.
Hawthorne trained you. I expect you troopers to do him proud.
We've lost a unit. Mission's over - we've failed.
Any of the other crew survive?
I’m afraid I had to shoot them all. I sensed they were “compromised” by the Bugs. Regrettably, I’m not much of a pilot, so this crude landing was the best I could manage.
You killed your own crew? Why?
I’m not at liberty to explain further, just accept that not every human can be trusted. It is imperative I reach Command with what I know.
Understood. We’ll call down a shuttle ASAP.
No. I’m not getting on another shuttle until I’ve vetted the crew. Get me to the main radio station and I’ll arrange my own transport.
And don’t feel guilty about Hawthorne, that whole situation was out of your control.
Colonel, if you’re done poking around in my head, we should move out.
Found the shuttle. And there’s Colonel Yarrow.
Colonel Ava Cortez reporting. We’re your ticket home.
Thank you for coming.
Yarrow has been killed! The mission's failed!
Radio station’s ready. Put in your call.

Command, this is Colonel Victor Yarrow. I need a shuttle. Before launch, place the crew under armed guard and give them a full medical scan. If nothing seems odd, send them for pick up at this location. But if you find something inexplicable in any individual, kill that person. With a flamethrower.
It’ll take a while to run those tests. Bugs aren’t going to wait that long.
Until I deliver my information, my survival is more important than the lives of all your troopers combined.
We’ll get you on that boat. But we're going to have to work on securing this area to buy us some time
There’s my exit. It seems I get to live another day.
For your first time leading the unit, you did well Cortez.  Now get your troops out of here.
You're alive, Colonel. I've been told that's what matters.
Fleet is standing by to evacuate.
Get everyone back to the dropships!
The Bugs are coming. I can sense them.
We're going to have to pull back to the inner defences and shorten our lines.
